subject: The feature 9,000 users begged for
preview_text: We listened. Here's what's dropping next week — and you get first access.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment when the beat drops and your phone just… farts? Flat, hollow, embarrassing. We've been tracking every single crash report, every support ticket, every desperate DM. And after 14,000 requests, we finally cracked it.

Next week, we're shipping something that's been in the works since day one. A dynamic bass boost that reads your song in real time — not just a static slider, but an AI that maps the drop and punches exactly when it needs to. Hip-Hop hits like a subwoofer. EDM rattles your earbuds. Rock kicks you in the chest. You heard it here first.

Open Bass Booster right now and tap the new 'Live Wave' tab. It's already live for a handful of users — yours is one of them. Drag the Boost slider to max and play your heaviest track. Feel the difference? That's just the warm-up. The real update lands in 7 days, and it'll make your current setup sound like a toy.
Stick around. This is the one that changes everything. P.S. — Premium users get the AI bass mapping unlocked first. If you're still on free, now's the time to upgrade. One tap, and you're in.
cta_text: Open Bass Booster & test Live Wave now
